note: Status is stated by the PM and checked against the repository: built = implemented, run on real NASA data, with automated tests of the code; partial = core implemented, missing parts stated; designed = specification only. Built does not mean scientifically validated. When a function is built, change its status here; nothing else changes.

items.name: Tamper-evident ledger
items.summary: Append-only, hash-chained, Ed25519-signed record of every ingest, derivation and qualification; anchored in Git and RFC 3161.
real: every file and result of the project is sealed in it
items.does: Seals every file and result with a hash and a signature, so later changes are detected.

items.name: Verification in your browser
items.summary: Every ledger entry and every data file shown on the page re-checked by the visitor's browser, byte-identical to the Python verifier. Raw NASA bytes are not published with the page.
real: verifies the real ledger in Chromium and Firefox
items.does: Repeats the ledger check inside the visitor's browser, with no server to trust.

items.name: Evidence Vault
items.summary: Primary files and source tables sealed as tiers 1–2; two keys with separate roles. Write-once storage and the seal event are designed.
real: NASA files re-downloaded with identical hashes
items.does: Keeps primary NASA files and source tables apart from derived results, by tier.

items.name: Portable black box
items.summary: The sealed core of a project on a USB stick, verifiable offline anywhere.
items.does: A portable sealed package of one experiment's evidence (design only).

items.name: Deviation register
items.summary: Every source conflict and every own error recorded with locators and affected results.
real: proof sheets matched to archives file by file
items.does: Records every disagreement between sources as an issue with its location, never silently corrected.

items.name: W3C PROV-O export
items.summary: The ledger exported as standard provenance (JSON-LD): 179 entities, 91 derivation links, 32 revisions, parsed by an RDF library.
items.does: Exports the ledger in the W3C PROV-O standard, readable by other provenance tools.

items.name: Transfer assessment engine
items.summary: Deterministic decision on whether a finding can inform another context; refuses with the blocking dimension named. Gate states for PMMA-100 are declared from the source audit, not yet computed from data.
items.does: Decides whether a finding may inform another case, and names the gate that blocks it.

items.name: Canonical evidence graph
items.summary: Sources, experiments, samples, measurements and claims as typed nodes; unresolved links never drawn as joins. Prototype for the PMMA-100 case.
items.does: Shows sources, claims and conflicts of the PMMA-100 case as a graph.

items.name: Comparable-run ranking
items.summary: Every row of NASA's BASS-II experimental table ranked against B6, condition by condition; unknown counts against. Ranks what the table records, not physical equivalence.
real: all 129 rows of the NASA table ranked
items.does: Ranks every run of the NASA table by how close its recorded conditions are to a reference run.

items.name: Physics gates computed from data
items.summary: Transfer gates computed from measured and recorded values (ruleset v0.2): run identity, observable, material and thickness, atmosphere and calibrated flow, regime, boundary conditions. Regime boundaries are order-of-magnitude.
real: gates computed for the four measured runs
items.does: Computes the comparability gates of two runs from their measured values.

items.name: Held-out transferability
items.summary: Four predictions sealed before the runs were acquired: 1 supported, 1 not supported, 2 not testable. The cross-oxygen test waits for the official data and for dim-flame tracking (ISS-029).
real: predictions sealed, then tested on runs acquired afterwards
items.does: Writes a prediction down and seals it before the data are opened, then scores it.

items.name: Literature relevance and comparability
items.summary: Relevance built: NASA–IBM INDUS retriever ranks passages of the project library for each open question, with file and page. Indexing published experiments by their conditions, for comparability, is designed.
items.does: Finds which papers address a question; relevance only, never comparability.

items.name: Evidence-backed synthesis
items.summary: AI-written summaries of findings in which every sentence cites records, checked automatically (citations exist, numbers appear in the cited records). General synthesis across sources is designed.
items.does: Summaries in which every sentence must cite existing records and every number must appear in them.

items.name: NASA data intelligence
items.summary: PSI-25 manifest of 695 files with sizes; 31 files (7.1 GiB) acquired with SHA-256 and re-downloaded identically; filename–table joins flagged, never corrected.
real: PSI-25 BASS-II files acquired and re-acquired
items.does: Downloads NASA PSI files, records their hashes, and keeps the inventory of what exists.

items.name: Flame-front measurement
items.summary: Frozen window rule (R-W4) as a platform module; four runs measured, identity confirmed against NASA proof sheets; B6 re-run byte-identical. Built does not mean validated: the luminous edge is not the pyrolysis front.
real: four runs measured from raw stills
items.does: Measures the flame front position in each raw image and fits the spread rate under a frozen rule.

items.name: Uncertainty in three layers
items.summary: Statistical, analyst-choice and physical-unknown layers kept apart; the luminous-edge offset and the flow at the sample have no bound and stay outside the interval.
items.does: Separates statistical uncertainty, analyst choice and unknown physical effects.

items.name: Data-quality anomaly detection
items.summary: Records, frames and flow overlay checked with declared thresholds; finds every detectable anomaly planted in the synthetic test and flags 22 items in NASA's table (for example final O2 1.6 % in B2).
real: the NASA table and the four runs
items.does: Flags gaps, saturation, flicker and suspect table values, with declared thresholds.

items.name: CRAM-1 thin-fuel theory
items.summary: de Ris, Delichatsios and EST thin-fuel rates with sourced PMMA properties; measured / lowest theory falls from 1.04 (100 µm) to 0.79 (400 µm). Never uses the fitted F = 4.76.
real: theory compared with the four measured runs
items.does: Computes the thin-fuel theoretical spread rate from sourced PMMA properties.

items.name: CRAM-2 combustion regime
items.summary: Damköhler and radiation numbers from the calibrated flow: thermal at air display 3 and above, transitional at 1–2, radiative side at 0. Order-of-magnitude boundaries; says when chemistry matters, does not model it.
real: regime groups for the flows of the measured runs
items.does: Places a run in the thermal, kinetic or radiative regime from Damköhler and radiation numbers.

items.name: CRAM-3 nonlinear dynamics
items.summary: Flame-area and front oscillation tested against surrogate data.
items.does: Nonlinear dynamics of the flame front (design only).

items.name: Flow calibration
items.summary: Air display to opposing-flow speed from NASA's fan calibration (U = 1.0066 × display, duct centreline); the speed at the sample surface stays unknown.
items.does: Converts the air display value to flow speed with NASA's fan calibration.

items.name: Other NASA combustion families
items.summary: BASS-II acquired and measured; SoFIE, SAFFIRE, SAME, FLEX, ACME and others identified and kept separate, not pooled.
items.does: Identifies the other NASA combustion investigations and keeps them separate, not pooled.

items.name: Reproducible analysis runs
items.summary: Analyses are parameterised scripts whose inputs, code hash and outputs are sealed in the ledger. Not yet re-run automatically in CI.
items.does: Rebuilds results from scripts whose code hash is sealed with the output.

items.name: Experiment memory
items.summary: Every result, decision, issue and idea with its history, citations and sealed files; failures kept as records.
items.does: One searchable record of results, decisions, issues and failures, each with its evidence.

items.name: Analysis records
items.summary: One report per relevant analysis: question, method, deviations, results, limits, reproduction. One record exists so far (AR-001).
items.does: A full written record of one analysis: inputs, rule, result, corrections.

items.name: Blind independent analyses (AAL)
items.summary: AI analysts work without seeing GFL results; their code is re-executed by GFL. First test done, defects recorded.
items.does: Other analysts measure the same data without seeing GFL's result; their code is re-executed.

items.name: AI findings, ranked by verification
items.summary: Claims made by seven AI models in blind, red-team and audit roles, ranked by what GFL's re-execution and data checks showed: upheld, partly upheld, not upheld, fabricated.
real: AI claims ranked by re-execution on B6
items.does: Ranks AI claims by what re-execution and the data showed, not by model confidence.

items.name: AI access over MCP
items.summary: Read-only MCP server: any AI client can query the memory, a record, the ledger check, the run ranking and the transfer engine; answers name their sources. Blind mode and an in-page assistant are designed.
items.does: Lets an AI client question the memory, ledger, ranking and transfer engine, read-only.

items.name: Validated predictive models
items.summary: Predictions only inside a validated regime and domain, with intervals; refusal outside it.
items.does: Predictions only inside a validated regime and domain, with intervals; refusal outside it.

items.name: Multiphysics simulation
items.summary: Coupled gas–solid simulation to test what measurements cannot isolate; outputs are derived evidence, never measurements.
items.does: Coupled gas–solid simulation to test what measurements cannot isolate; outputs are derived evidence, never measurements.

items.name: Fire-scenario analysis
items.summary: For a cabin scenario: which experiments give relevant evidence, what transfers, what does not. An evidence map, not a prediction.
items.does: For a cabin scenario: which experiments give relevant evidence, what transfers, what does not. An evidence map, not a prediction.

items.name: Model predictive control
items.summary: What a real MPC would need: a validated dynamic model, horizon, objective, constraints and solver. Not part of the product.
items.does: What a real MPC would need: a validated dynamic model, horizon, objective, constraints and solver. Not part of the product.

items.name: ECLSS decision support
items.summary: Evidence views for environmental-control engineers, with stated limits; never an automatic action.
items.does: Evidence views for environmental-control engineers, with stated limits; never an automatic action.

items.name: Sensor integration
items.summary: New measurement streams sealed with instrument records and explicit clock offsets.
items.does: New measurement streams sealed with instrument records and explicit clock offsets.

items.name: Dynamic dependency analysis
items.summary: Correlation, mutual information and transfer entropy between burn time series, tested against surrogates.
items.does: Correlation, mutual information and transfer entropy between burn time series, tested against surrogates.

items.name: State estimation
items.summary: Kalman-type filtering of front position and speed; needs a second, non-luminous front observation.
items.does: Kalman-type filtering of front position and speed; needs a second, non-luminous front observation.

items.name: Physical model and parameter registry
items.summary: Every equation and property with source, domain and uncertainty in one place; partly present in the analysis modules' source table.
items.does: Every equation and property with source, domain and uncertainty in one place; partly present in the analysis modules' source table.
